verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe pushing data you already have (from your DB, CSV/JSON, or a scraper you build yourself) into Typesense — this confirms the founder must still write or bring their own indexing pipeline/scraper rather than use an official first-party crawler or pre-built connectors (e.g., for CMS, SaaS apps) as Algolia offers. No evidence pack item shows an official Typesense crawler or connector ecosystem.
